title: spec-artifacts-process Markdown record mapping
description: The schema mappings.yaml itself validates against, so a malformed mapping is a schema error rather than a reader's surprise (FR-011).

authority.description: The Markdown is the sole authority; the record is a derived projection.

round_trip.description: A record is rebuilt from the document, never the other way round. No property is invented and no default is supplied.

not_modelled.description: Concepts this module deliberately does not model, each with the owner it belongs to. An absent property reads as 'owned elsewhere' rather than 'not yet written' (FR-013-AC-6).

role.description: FR-013: one model, one role. A definition is authored; an evidence-act records that a human or a named command was declared as the source of evidence. Neither is a run.

dropped_frontmatter_keys.description: Frontmatter keys the model does not declare. The frontmatter schemas admit additional properties and the emitted models are sealed, so these cannot reach the record; listing them makes the loss declared rather than silent.

heading.description: section / table / typed-table / sysml-fence / ocl-clause: the level-2 heading.

whole_body.description: section: the whole authored body below the H1, for an archetype that asserts no section.

columns.description: The declared column list, present only where the locator asserts one.

open_columns.description: table: the record property that carries the cells of an open header, by column name. Used where the locator asserts an id column and no column list, so the header is the author's and this module cannot name it.

fields.description: table / typed-table: column name -> record property and its cell parse.

alternate.description: The same declarations in the alternate authored form. One artifact carries one form; a document with both is rejected `both-forms`.

separator.description: list: the delimiter a frontmatter string is split on.

source.description: list: where the bullets or the string come from.

parse.description: `text` carries the trimmed cell; `id` checks it against the locator's id_pattern; `status-marker` splits marker from note; `trace-tokens` expands the two shorthands and the lone `-`; `enum` checks a declared vocabulary.
